name: Create calendarStore.ts
description: Create Zustand store for calendar state management with current date, selected date, view mode

details: Define interface with currentDate, selectedDate, viewMode ('month' | 'agenda' | 'day-detail')
Add selectors for current month days, selected day events
Add actions: setCurrentDate, setSelectedDate, setViewMode, navigateMonth, goToToday
getMonthDays() - returns array of days in current month with padding
getWeekDays() - returns 7 days from selected date
getDayEvents(date) - returns events for specific date

validation: Store is typed with TypeScript interfaces
Actions update state and persist to localStorage
notes: Keep store minimal - event data comes from other stores
